fusions.name: Pauldron Check
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away and drives a shoulder plate into it for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Scales
fusions.desc: Bursts your outer layer of plates outward, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Plate Over Plate
fusions.desc: Locks a second layer of plate over the first: it absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Proofed Brigandine
fusions.desc: Conjures a brigandine of riveted plates: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
